sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Introduced `SA_SNAPSHOT_FORMAT_VERSION` ('1.1'), replacing the two hardcoded `version: '1.0'` literals in `saveTableDataToDisk()`/`captureSubtableSnapshot()`. Load-time hydration (`_hydrateAndRenderFromSnapshotData()`) now checks the saved format version via a new `_snapshotVersionAtLeast()` helper before applying the WIP.2/WIP.3 fast-path restoration below, so pre-existing `.json.gz` files (format 1.0) keep loading exactly as before — full Relationships re-fetch, no cdtoc tracklist-toggle restore — with no behavior change and no new user-facing warning dialog. This is distinct from the script's own `// @version` — it's a save-file format version, now actually meaningful instead of an inert label.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: `cdtoc` pages' tracklist show/hide toggle now survives a Save-to-disk/Load-from-disk round trip. Previously `data-cdtoc-tracklist-html`/`-visible` (row-level dataset attributes read by `_cdtocInitTracklistToggles()`) were never captured by `saveTableDataToDisk()` — only `<td>` cell HTML was serialized, never `<tr>` dataset — so the toggle silently no-opped after every disk-load. Fixed via a new top-level `cdtocTracklistData` field (index-aligned with `dataToSave.rows`, mirroring the existing `discOfficialCategories` pattern), restored onto each reconstructed `<tr>` in `_hydrateAndRenderFromSnapshotData()` before `_cdtocInitTracklistToggles()` runs (gated by format version — see WIP.4).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The "Relationships" injected column (`td.mb-rel-cell`) now round-trips through Save-to-disk/Load-from-disk with **zero** network/IndexedDB activity when every cell was already fully populated at save time. Previously `mb-rel-cell` was explicitly excluded from serialization, so every disk-load re-triggered a live WS/2 fetch to repopulate it — even though its icons are plain hotlinked `` URLs (never `blob:`), so nothing actually prevented a verbatim restore. `saveTableDataToDisk()`/`captureSubtableSnapshot()` now serialize `mb-rel-cell` cells via a shared `_buildDiskCellData()` helper, adding `mbid`/`relDone` fields (mirrored from the live cell's own dataset) only for that column. `_hydrateAndRenderFromSnapshotData()` applies those fields to the reconstructed `` (class + dataset) so `_ensureRelCell()`'s existence check and `initRelationshipsColumn()`'s `td.dataset.mbid && !td.dataset.relDone` candidate filter both correctly treat a restored cell as already done — a row saved mid-fetch (rare) still completes normally on load. Also fixes a latent completion-signal gap this change would otherwise have introduced: when every candidate cell is already done, `initRelationshipsColumn()` previously returned before ever showing the completion toast/status segment, meaning `#mb-info-display-rel` — what `waitForRelationshipsComplete()` (Playwright test helper) and real users both watch for — would never become visible for an all-done page; it now fires the same signal (with 0 elapsed time, 0 fetches) on that path too. New `sa_rel_idb_ttl_days` setting (default 30, mirrors the existing `sa_art_idb_image_ttl_days` for CAA/EAA) replaces the hardcoded 7-day `_REL_IDB_TTL_MS` constant for the Relationships WS2 IndexedDB cache.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: tests: added artist-events performance-comparison instrumentation — `tests/live/artist-events-interactions.spec.js` (global/column filter, sort both directions, header-badge sanity, uniq-dropdown cache-invalidation correctness), `tests/support/capture-interaction-perf.js` (median-of-5 timing for global filter/column filter/sort/uniq-dropdown cold-vs-warm-open, written per-branch to `tests/snapshots/artist-events/interaction-perf-<branch>.json` so `main` and a performance-focused branch can be compared side by side), and `tests/support/capture-snapshots.js` extended with `post-filter.html`/`post-sort.html` full-DOM regression snapshots for `artist-events` (catching a rendering regression a canonical filter/sort action could introduce that no single correctness assertion would catch). All three load via the newly-captured `tests/fixtures/saved-data/artist-events.json.gz` disk fixture (`tests/support/capture-fixture.js`, extended with an `artist-events` entry and `seedGmValues`/`renderTimeout` support) rather than a live 42-page fetch. Canonical filter/sort/uniq-drop targets shared across all three via new `tests/support/artistEventsFixture.js`, so they can't drift apart. New `waitForActualRowCount()` helper in `tests/support/filterSortAssertions.js` — a stronger completion signal than the existing status-text-based waits for an action that narrows a large single-table page then widens it back out (confirmed empirically that `#mb-filter-status-display`/`.mb-row-count-stat` both update before the tbody rebuild and the `#mb-render-heading` chunked-render overlay have actually finished catching up, on `artist-events`' 4174 rows). No `ShowAllEntityData.user.js` changes — pure test-infra additions, per this project's existing precedent for test-only commits.
